products.title: Pride and Prejudice
products.author: Jane Austen
products.description: Set in Regency-era England, the novel follows Elizabeth Bennet and the wealthy Mr. Darcy as their initial misunderstandings and personal prejudices gradually give way to love. Through witty dialogue and memorable characters, Jane Austen explores social class, marriage, family expectations, pride, and the importance of looking beyond first impressions.

products.title: The Great Gatsby
products.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
products.description: Set in 1920s New York, The Great Gatsby follows Nick Carraway as he becomes acquainted with the mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby, who throws extravagant parties while longing to reunite with Daisy Buchanan, his former lover. Beneath the glamour and wealth, the novel explores obsession, social class, betrayal, the illusion of success, and the decline of the American Dream.

products.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
products.author: Gabriel García Márquez
products.description: In the town of Macondo, seven generations of one family are destined to live through extraordinary love, devastating wars, impossible wonders, and haunting repetitions of the past. As the Buendía family rises and falls, the line between reality and magic begins to blur, revealing how loneliness can shape an entire legacy. Gabriel García Márquez's unforgettable masterpiece is a dreamlike tale of family, fate, memory, and the cycles of history.

products.title: Things Fall Apart
products.author: Chinua Achebe
products.description: Set in late nineteenth-century Nigeria, Things Fall Apart follows Okonkwo, a respected Igbo warrior determined to avoid the weakness he associates with his father. His life and community are disrupted by the arrival of Christian missionaries and British colonial authorities. The novel explores cultural identity, tradition, masculinity, pride, colonialism, and the devastating consequences of social change.

products.title: A Brief History of Time
products.author: Stephen Hawking

products.title: Cosmos
products.author: Carl Sagan
products.description: Cosmos explores the vast universe and the evolution of matter, life, and human consciousness. Carl Sagan explains scientific discoveries, the origin of life, the evolution of galaxies, space exploration, the human brain, and the history of scientific thought in an accessible and engaging way. The book connects science and civilisation while encouraging readers to understand humanity’s place in the universe.

products.title: The Selfish Gene
products.author: Richard Dawkins
products.description: What if evolution is best understood not through the survival of individuals, but through the survival of their genes? In The Selfish Gene, Richard Dawkins challenges conventional ways of thinking about life, explaining how genes influence behaviour, cooperation, competition, and survival across generations. Blending evolutionary biology with thought-provoking examples, this influential book offers a fascinating new perspective on why living things behave the way they do.

products.title: Sapiens
products.author: Yuval Noah Harari
products.description: How did a species of ordinary apes end up ruling the planet—and what did it take to get there? In Sapiens, Yuval Noah Harari traces humanity's astonishing journey from prehistoric hunter-gatherers to the architects of modern civilisation. Through revolutions in thought, farming, money, religion, and science, he challenges familiar ideas about progress and power, inviting readers to question what makes us human and where our future might lead.

products.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
products.author: Jared Diamond
products.description: Why did some civilisations conquer vast territories while others struggled to resist them? In Guns, Germs, and Steel, Jared Diamond investigates the forces that shaped the unequal paths of human societies. From geography and domesticated crops to infectious diseases and technological advances, he explores how environmental conditions influenced the rise of powerful civilisations. This thought-provoking work challenges familiar explanations of global inequality and offers a sweeping perspective on the forces that shaped human history.

products.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
products.author: Andrew Hunt & David Thomas
products.description: Writing code that works is only the beginning—building software that remains reliable, adaptable, and easy to maintain is the real challenge. The Pragmatic Programmer shares practical lessons for developers who want to think beyond simply completing a task. Through real-world examples and timeless programming principles, David Thomas and Andrew Hunt explore debugging, automation, flexible design, problem-solving, and professional growth, helping programmers develop the mindset and habits of truly effective software craftspeople.

products.title: Clean Code
products.author: Robert C. Martin
products.description: This book teaches programmers how to write clean, readable, and maintainable code using practical software craftsmanship principles. It covers meaningful naming, effective functions and classes, code formatting, error handling, unit testing, and test-driven development. Through detailed case studies, Robert C. Martin demonstrates how to identify poor coding practices and refactor existing code into simpler, more reliable software. It is suitable for software developers, programmers, and students who want to improve their coding practices.

products.title: Below the Barrel
products.author: Tanisha Headley
products.description: Koa and Maliah are thrown back together on the World Surf Championship Tour after a devastating breakup. Forced to work as a team while their every move is filmed for reality TV, they must confront the painful history between them. But Maliah may not know the real reason their relationship ended. As buried truths surface and their futures in surfing hang in the balance, can they overcome their fears and discover whether their love deserves a second chance?

products.title: The Kite Runner
products.author: Khaled Hosseini
products.description: Set in Afghanistan, The Kite Runner follows Amir, a privileged boy, and Hassan, the son of his father's servant. Their childhood friendship is shattered by a traumatic event, leaving Amir burdened by guilt. Years later, after fleeing to America, Amir gets an opportunity to return to Taliban-ruled Afghanistan and confront his past. The novel explores friendship, loyalty, betrayal, family, social inequality, and the possibility of redemption.

products.title: A Thousand Splendid Suns
products.author: Khaled Hosseini
products.description:
Two women. One cruel household. A friendship that becomes their only hope.

Mariam and Laila are born a generation apart, yet fate brings them together under the same roof in war-torn Afghanistan. Trapped in an abusive marriage and surrounded by conflict, they discover an unexpected bond that grows stronger than fear, rivalry, or despair. As war reshapes their country and threatens everything they hold dear, both women must find the courage to protect the people they love. A moving story of friendship, sacrifice, resilience, and the extraordinary strength of women in the face of unimaginable hardship.

products.title: Kafka on the Shore
products.author: Haruki Murakami
products.description:
A runaway teenager. An old man who talks to cats. And a world where the impossible refuses to stay impossible.

At fifteen, Kafka Tamura escapes his home, haunted by a disturbing prophecy and searching for a life beyond his father's shadow. Meanwhile, elderly Nakata sets out on an unexpected journey after a strange encounter turns his quiet existence upside down. Their separate paths begin to intertwine in a world of mysterious forests, unexplained murders, falling fish, and secrets that blur the boundaries between dreams and reality. As the mysteries deepen, both must confront forces they can barely understand in this haunting, surreal exploration of identity, fate, memory, and the hidden connections between people.
